tests.fixture_scope: controlled common subprocess fixtures only; no source normalization or publisher requests

changes: Independent complete selected originals/common/registry/config maps before and after subprocess; stale/falsified source maps cannot hide changes.
Exact selected source configuration must match bound originals/configs/flagstaff.json before output creation.
Family log path refuses unsafe/symlink components and must match saved common receipt and exact registry verify argv.
Exact family log bytes copied; derivative preserves original common receipt and all acceptance/false gates unchanged.
Explicit family/common status consistency; valid complete and incomplete family results supported without upgrading acceptance.
Source/output overlap, output symlink and all referenced collector/config/log symlinks fail closed.
Failure receipt reports actual unchanged/changed input/source/runtime results rather than asserting mutation never occurred.

image_policy.note: Helper itself uses stdlib file hashing/JSON/subprocess only; actual common readonly path reviewed, not newly executed.

limits: Full actual common Flagstaff invocation deferred until root/peer readiness signal.
The helper verifies an explicitly selected trusted collector/runtime; this is not a sandbox for arbitrary hostile code.
Independent runtime installation reinspection remains actual common doctor responsibility; helper independently binds stable runtime.json.
Source review does not add legal/source completeness, source navigation repair, edition, native capture, jurisdiction closure or acquisition/resume credit.
